awkward_potion.descripcion: It does nothing when you drink it, and yet it is the most important potion in the game: almost all the others start from it.
awkward_potion.notas: If a recipe isn’t working, it is almost always because you skipped this step.

fire_resistance_potion.descripcion: Makes you immune to fire and lava while it lasts. It is what makes the Nether a place you can actually stay in.
fire_resistance_potion.notas: There is no level II: either you are immune or you aren’t. Always take a couple before going through the portal.

harming_potion.descripcion: Deals instant damage to whoever gets it. Made from the Potion of Healing by adding a fermented spider eye.
harming_potion.notas: Thrown, it is one of the hardest-hitting weapons in the game. Careful: it heals undead mobs instead of hurting them.

healing_potion.descripcion: Heals you instantly instead of little by little. The best safety net you can carry in a fight.
healing_potion.notas: Since it is instant, redstone does nothing to it: there is no duration to extend. It hurts undead mobs instead of healing them, so thrown it works as a weapon.

invisibility_potion.descripcion: Makes you invisible to mobs and other players. Made from the Potion of Night Vision by adding a fermented spider eye.
invisibility_potion.notas: Your armor and whatever you hold are still visible, so to truly go unnoticed you have to take everything off.

leaping_potion.descripcion: You jump higher and take less fall damage. Very useful for building and for getting around mountains.
leaping_potion.notas: Rabbits don’t always drop their foot, so bring a sword with Looting.

night_vision_potion.descripcion: You see clearly in total darkness, even underwater. Exploring caves stops being guesswork.
night_vision_potion.notas: It is also the step before the Potion of Invisibility.

poison_potion.descripcion: Takes health away little by little, but never kills outright.
poison_potion.notas: Since it doesn’t kill, it is used to soften targets before finishing them. Spiders and undead mobs are immune.

regeneration_potion.descripcion: Heals you little by little while it lasts. It helps you recover during a fight, not survive a single big hit.
regeneration_potion.notas: The ghast tear is the hard part: you have to kill ghasts in the Nether, and they don’t always drop one.

slow_falling_potion.descripcion: You float down and take no damage when you land. The safety net for anyone building high or flying with elytra.
slow_falling_potion.notas: The membrane is dropped by phantoms, the ones that show up when you haven’t slept for days.

slowness_potion.descripcion: Makes whoever gets it move much more slowly. Made from the Potion of Swiftness by adding a fermented spider eye.
slowness_potion.notas: Thrown at a group of enemies, it gives you plenty of time to pick your escape route.

strength_potion.descripcion: Raises your melee damage. The cheapest way to hit harder without changing weapons.
strength_potion.notas: It only affects hits with a weapon or your hand. It doesn’t improve bows.

swiftness_potion.descripcion: You run quite a bit faster. Sugar comes from sugar cane, so it is one of the cheapest potions there is.
swiftness_potion.notas: Great for exploring and for running from fights you don’t want.

water_bottle.descripcion: The starting point of every potion. Take a glass bottle and right-click any water.
water_bottle.notas: On its own it does nothing: it is just the container. With a fermented spider eye it becomes a Potion of Weakness, the only one you can make without going through the Awkward Potion.

water_breathing_potion.descripcion: You breathe underwater without your air bar going down. Essential for raiding an ocean monument.
water_breathing_potion.notas: Pufferfish can be caught by fishing, so it is easier than it looks.

weakness_potion.descripcion: Lowers the damage whoever gets it deals. The only useful potion made straight from a water bottle, without the Awkward Potion.
weakness_potion.notas: Its most important use isn’t fighting: thrown at a zombie villager and followed by a golden apple, it cures it and leaves you huge permanent discounts.
